doc: Forbidden-edge matrix (§6). Dependencies that must NEVER exist. Each has a machine-checkable probe the architecture checkpoint runs. severity FAIL edges fail the checkpoint outright.

edges.why: the Independent Oracle must be constructible with NO market input; else it is not independent and cannot adjudicate market mispricing
edges.probe: oracle modules must not read a Kalshi field as an INPUT to p_mech/p_oracle

edges.why: lookahead leakage inflates offline metrics and never survives live
edges.probe: no centered/negative-offset windows or future-indexed reads in active feature builders

edges.to: pre-settlement model input or prospective capture at decision time
edges.why: the outcome cannot inform the decision that predicts it
edges.probe: prospective_capture leak-guard rejects settlement fields; capture rows write exact_yes=null at decision time

edges.why: metrics must have one backend owner; browser math drifts silently
edges.probe: no Brier/EV/BSS arithmetic implemented in site HTML/JS
control and treatment write disjoint state files/keys

edges.why: fitting on test leaks the answer
edges.probe: recalibration/scaler fit uses train-window rows only (window-split before fit)
